line: One real day of German long-distance trains between Köln and Frankfurt, drafted as a train graph: the real line straightens into the distance axis, and the high-speed line and the Rhine valley draw two different slopes.
line_cn: 科隆到法兰克福之间真实的一天长途列车，画成一张列车运行图：真实的线路被拉直成里程轴，高速新线和莱茵河谷线画出两种完全不同的斜率。
uses: A railway, metro or bus line's real timetable over one day
Two routes or two services between the same places, compared
Clock-face timetables, overtakes, meets and gaps in service
